steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Impossible! Impossible...!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: H-how could this be?! Skullshatterer, Skullshatterer!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: W-we can't let Misha see this...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Who here knows first aid? Get them over here now!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Damn it, why did Mephisto refuse to come? What is he doing?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: He kept talking about some 'other plan'... What the hell is with that?!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: If he was here, we would've been able to save so many people!

steps.name: W
steps.text: We can't count on that guy anyway. He doesn't care about his comrades anyway.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't blame yourself for things you can't control.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Thanks for covering us, W...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: At least, we were able to bring him back.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you want to thank me, do it through your actions.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Of course. We'll cover your escape... However, I have one request--

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Please promise to take care of Misha.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Of course. After all...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I am still of use to you, right?

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: We...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Please let me spend some time with Skullshatterer alone.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I will... take care of him.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Fine.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: W, it's a promise. One that you must keep.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I know, I know~

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I just said--

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Let me spend some time with him alone.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But you should get going.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Lungmen and Rhodes Island will come barging in here any moment now.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I guess the people here are going to die too.

steps.name: W
steps.text: My, oh my, what a dilemma we have.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Misha, so many more people are going to die because of you...

steps.name: W
steps.text: What a pity.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: You're really getting on my nerves, W.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: You won't get anything from me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wooahh, scary~

steps.name: W
steps.text: You know, that bunny girl seems to really care about you~

steps.name: W
steps.text: But, that Ch'en lady seems different.

steps.name: W
steps.text: She won't show mercy to anyone.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Maybe she'll decide to spare your life, because she needs you...

steps.name: W
steps.text: But you've seen enough in Ursus to know what will happen after that, right?

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you come with me now, it's still not too late.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Although... you'd still have to watch all our Reunion friends sacrifice themselves...

steps.name: W
steps.text: I suppose that's just their fate though.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Such pitiful things.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ah, that's right.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Even though you saw everything that happened...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Y'know, ahh, how do I put this... I really don't have the spare energy to drag Skullshatterer back to Chernobog...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Shut up!

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm just telling the truth.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I mean, the situation here is hopeless after all~

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hurry and let me know once you've cleared your head, okay?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I swear I'll...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Bring Skullshatterer back to life.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Skullshatterer isn't dead... Skullshatterer cannot die.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: If he was here, he'd protect us... all of us.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I just know... this is what he would've done.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Everyone is just like me. We're all Infected.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I am also... one of them.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: We have nowhere to go...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Everyone... needs to be protected.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: This...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...is Skullshatterer's legacy.
